title: Antiquary

inlines.v: AN'TIQUARY, noun [Latin antiquarius.] One who studies into the history of ancient things, as statues, coins, medals, paintings, inscriptions, books and manuscripts, or searches for them, and explains their origin and purport; one versed in antiquity.
